cases.name: stranger-log-id
cases.says: a stranger name carrying only the log's key id names no trusted key

cases.name: stranger-pi-id
cases.says: a stranger name carrying only pi's key id names no listed witness

cases.name: stranger-del
cases.says: DEL is permitted in a stranger signature name

cases.name: stranger-three-bytes
cases.says: three decoded bytes cannot carry the four-byte key id

cases.name: policy-log-only
cases.says: replay genesis and policy; logkey3 is named only on the policy log line, never by log_key

cases.name: forged-pi-without-quorum
cases.says: the forged pi line is cosignature before the independently short quorum

comment: Serve every head over served's honest tiles. Fresh readers use only trust.cbor; the informed reader replays the two named entries in order and uses the replacement policy, retaining only keys published through log_key. Requests are checked separately with consumer_net, not as checkpoints; accept is a semantic result, not a new refusal code.

cases.name: request-this-network
cases.says: verify the signature, then require net to equal consumer_net before displaying the request

cases.name: request-other-network
cases.says: verify the signature, then require net to equal consumer_net before displaying the request

request-other-network.says: MUST also refuse a request whose `net` is not the network it serves, before

request-this-network.says: MUST also refuse a request whose `net` is not the network it serves, before

forged-pi-without-quorum.says: a cosignature line whose name **and** key id match a listed witness does not verify

policy-log-only.says: Norn takes the log key it verifies with from `log_key`, never from here

stranger-del.says: MUST NOT contain an ASCII control character below U+0020

stranger-log-id.says: What follows the key id is judged by the trusted key whose name and key id

stranger-pi-id.says: What follows the key id is judged by the trusted key whose name and key id

stranger-three-bytes.says: and canonical padded base64 that decodes to at least the 4-byte `key_id`.
